01 · Who we are

The studio behind The Cute Side of Life

Founded by filmmaker and illustrator Nacho Arjona, Naolito has created The Cute Side of Life since 2009. Our Málaga studio makes the art and animation for every partner.

09 · The partnership

What we are looking for in an agency

An active programme for The Cute Side of Life, with clear targets.

Territories

  • Spain and Latin America
  • Europe
  • United States
  • Exclusivity by territory and category

Categories

  • Priority: apparel, wall art, giftware, stationery
  • Growth: toys, publishing, promotions
  • Digital and animation rights stay with Naolito

Term and targets

  • 2 or 3 years
  • Annual minimums agreed together
  • Quarterly reports

What we bring

  • Hundreds of finished designs
  • Our own animation studio
  • 1.2M followers
  • Disney+ and books in print
